post.description:
Read the current revision of a Wikipedia (or sister-project) article by exact title: full wikitext (or HTML with body), abstract, categories, redirects, connected Wikidata QID, license, and revision credibility signals. Use structured-contents instead when you want infobox fields, sections or references already parsed. From https://de.wikipedia.org/wiki/Berlin pass name `Berlin` and project `dewiki`. Not a search: titles must match exactly. Supply fields or body separately. For projected body content, use article_body.wikitext or article_body.html in fields.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
Usage-based billing; Default request estimate: $0.0001 USD (not a fixed price). Declared unit rate: $0.0001 USD per provider_credit. Account-specific pricing and final settlement may differ.
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

body.description: Article body format when fields is omitted: wikitext (default), html, both, or none. Omit body entirely when using fields, including when no body is needed.

fields.description: Return only the named fields, using dot notation; at most 50 entries. Omit body when using fields. Include article_body.wikitext or article_body.html here to select body content.

language.description: Wikimedia language code, for example `en`, `fr` or `zh-yue`. Returns the article from any project in that language; combine with project to pin one wiki.

limit.description:
Most matching articles to return, 1 to 10. More than one only helps when no project is pinned and the title exists on several wikis.

Provider reference: minimum 1; maximum 10; default 1.

name.description: Exact article title as on the wiki, for example `Marie_Curie` or `Marie Curie`. Case-sensitive: Wikipedia titles start with a capital letter. From a URL such as https://fr.wikipedia.org/wiki/Marie_Curie, use the part after /wiki/.

project.description: Wikimedia project identifier: language code plus project code, for example `enwiki` (English Wikipedia), `frwiki`, `dewiki`, `enwiktionary` or `eswikivoyage`. Defaults to `enwiki` when neither project nor language is given. `reference/projects` lists every identifier.

production.description: Response to the displayed request; data and timestamps can change.

abstract.description: Short plain-text summary of the article.

additional_entities.description: Other Wikidata entities used on the page.

article_body.description: Selected body formats. Omitted with body=none or when excluded by fields.

categories.description: Categories the article belongs to: name and url.

date_modified.description: When the current revision was saved.

event.description: The pipeline event behind this revision: type and date_created.

identifier.description: MediaWiki page ID; not accepted as lookup input.

image.description: Main image: content_url, width, height and thumbnail.

in_language.description: Language: identifier (for example en), name and direction.

is_part_of.description: Project: identifier (for example enwiki), code, name and url.

license.description: Licenses for the content, normally CC BY-SA 4.0, with name and url.

main_entity.description: Connected Wikidata item: identifier (QID such as Q7186) and url. Pass the QID to wikidata/item.

name.description: Article title as displayed on the page.

namespace.description: MediaWiki namespace; 0 is the main article namespace.

protection.description: Edit and move protections, absent when unprotected.

redirects.description: Titles that redirect to this article: name and url.

version.description: Current revision: identifier, editor, comment, tags, size, and credibility signals under scores (revertrisk, referencerisk, referenceneed) and maintenance_tags.

200.description:
Returns the tool result directly as an array of article objects. With fields, articles contain only the selected fields. body selects wikitext, html, both, or none. No article property is required because field projection is supported.

post.description:
Read a Wikipedia article pre-parsed into JSON: one-line description, abstract, infobox fields, sections as paragraphs and lists with links, references and tables. Best for extracting facts such as a person's birth date or a city's population without parsing HTML. Beta upstream, with the most complete coverage on en, de, fr, es, pt, it, nl, cy and id Wikipedia. Exact title, as for articles/lookup.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
Usage-based billing; Default request estimate: $0.0001 USD (not a fixed price). Declared unit rate: $0.0001 USD per provider_credit. Account-specific pricing and final settlement may differ.
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

fields.description:
Return only these fields, in dot notation, for example `name`, `abstract`, `url`, `version.identifier`. Omit for the full record. Wikimedia returns exactly the fields named.

Provider reference: maximum 50.

language.description: Wikimedia language code, for example `en`, `fr` or `zh-yue`. Returns the article from any project in that language; combine with project to pin one wiki.

limit.description:
Most matching articles to return, 1 to 10. More than one only helps when no project is pinned and the title exists on several wikis.

Provider reference: minimum 1; maximum 10; default 1.

name.description: Exact article title as on the wiki, for example `Marie_Curie` or `Marie Curie`. Case-sensitive: Wikipedia titles start with a capital letter. From a URL such as https://fr.wikipedia.org/wiki/Marie_Curie, use the part after /wiki/.

project.description: Wikimedia project identifier: language code plus project code, for example `enwiki` (English Wikipedia), `frwiki`, `dewiki`, `enwiktionary` or `eswikivoyage`. Defaults to `enwiki` when neither project nor language is given. `reference/projects` lists every identifier.

200.description:
Parsed articles matching the exact title in the selected project or language. Carries no article_body, categories, templates or redirects; use articles/lookup for those. Empty when none match. Priced per article returned.

The response contains the tool result directly.

| `url` | string | Canonical article URL, for citation. |
| `date_created` | string |  |
| `date_modified` | string | When the current revision was saved. |
| `in_language` | object | Language: identifier (for example en), name and direction. |
| `is_part_of` | object | Project: identifier (for example enwiki), code, name and url. |
| `namespace` | object | MediaWiki namespace; 0 is the main article namespace. |
| `main_entity` | object | Connected Wikidata item: identifier (QID such as Q7186) and url. Pass the QID to wikidata/item. |
| `additional_entities` | object[] | Other Wikidata entities used on the page. |
| `image` | object | Main image: content_url, width, height and thumbnail. |
| `license` | object[] | Licenses for the content, normally CC BY-SA 4.0, with name and url. |
| `version` | object | Current revision: identifier, editor, comment, tags, size, and credibility signals under scores (revertrisk, referencerisk, referenceneed) and maintenance_tags. |
| `description` | string | One-line description, shorter than abstract. |
| `infoboxes` | object[] | Parsed infoboxes as trees of parts; field parts carry name and plain-text value. |
| `sections` | object[] | Article body as trees of parts: sections, paragraphs (plain-text value with links and citations), lists and table references. The first section is Abstract. |
| `references` | object[] | References cited in sections, by identifier, with type, template metadata (title, url, author) and rendered text. |
| `tables` | object[] | Tables referenced from sections: identifier, headers, rows and confidence_score. |

post.description:
Read a Wikidata item by QID: labels, descriptions and aliases in every language, all statements (property values with qualifiers and references) and links to its article on each wiki. Use for structured facts such as dates, identifiers and relationships, or to find an entity's article title in another language through sitelinks. Beta upstream; a very large item can fail.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
Usage-based billing; Default request estimate: $0.0001 USD (not a fixed price). Declared unit rate: $0.0001 USD per provider_credit. Account-specific pricing and final settlement may differ.
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

fields.description:
Return only these fields, in dot notation, for example `entity.labels.en` or `entity.statements.P569`. Omit for the full record.

Provider reference: maximum 50.

identifier.description: Wikidata item ID (QID), for example `Q42`. An article's main_entity.identifier is its QID.

200.description:
One Wikidata item, latest revision. Entity data is CC0.

The response contains the tool result directly.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | string | The entity identifier, for example Q42. |
| `url` | string | Entity page on wikidata.org. |
| `date_modified` | string |  |
| `entity` | object | The entity: identifier, type (item or property), labels, descriptions and aliases keyed by language code, statements keyed by property ID (values, qualifiers, references) and sitelinks keyed by project, for example sitelinks.enwiki.title. |
| `version` | object | Revision of the entity page. |
| `license` | object[] | CC0 for Wikidata entity data. |
